question: Where have the Zucknicks travelled post virus scare?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Within Texas."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the first sentence of the third paragraph:
 
 
• *"Diana Zucknick and her husband, Paul, visited 14 countries in the five years before COVID-19 caused them to hunker down at their Austin, Texas, home."*
 
 
 
• The question is asking about the post-virus scare travel destination of the Zucknicks.
 
• The Zucknicks have travelled within Texas post-virus scare.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Australia)** **is incorrect** as the Zucknicks did not travel to Australia.
 
• **Option 3 (USA) is incorrect** as the Zucknicks did not travel outside of Texas.
 
• **Option 4 (Hong kong) is incorrect** as the Zucknicks did not travel outside of the United States.
